research_summary: Candidates: (1) The Lamplighter's Last Drop (kindness costs the giver, gentle tale) 84; (2) the clockmaker who stops one clock; (3) the ferryman's last coin. Titles: 'The Lamplighter's Last Drop (A Short Story)'. Thumbnails: the lit lane, one dark lamp. Hooks: A) 'Tomas had one flame, and three lamps to light.' (pick) B) 'The third lamp would not catch.' C) 'What do you do with your last drop?'. Loops: primary = will the third lamp light; micro = the oil is gone, his own last drop; reversal = he gives it away and his own light goes out; payoff = he walks home under the three lamps he lit. Self-score 12/14. Claims: none; invented fable, labelled a story (FICTIONAL ASSUMPTION). Gap: no research data on line-art Shorts (vidIQ credits exhausted); web research found only vendor pages and YouTube's own note that minimal-animation storytime is an established format; the channel's own story family scored 1.22x on 12 videos with 58% viewed, so this is a small, labelled test. Channel check: see runbrief on the day. Learning applied: payoff early, 40-55 s, concrete object hook, series promise. Growth: lever = a new visual format on the story family that already holds viewers (58% viewed); policy check = every story has its own hand-written scene code and a unique plot, no template reuse, labelled fiction, no sensitive topic.

english.pinned_comment: What would you have done with the last drop: keep it, or give it away? Tell me below.

scenes.text: Tomas had one flame, and three lamps to light.
Every evening he carried it down Ash Lane.
The first lamp caught at once.
But the third would not catch. Its oil was gone.
His own lantern held one last drop. Without it, he would walk home in the dark.
The third lamp lit. His lantern went out.
And Tomas walked home slowly, beneath the three lamps he had lit.

scenes.text: टोमास के पास एक लौ थी, और जलाने के लिए तीन लैंप।
हर शाम वह उसे लिए ऐश लेन से गुज़रता था।
पर तीसरा नहीं जला। उसका तेल ख़त्म हो चुका था।
उसकी अपनी लालटेन में बस आख़िरी बूँद बची थी। उसके बिना, उसे अँधेरे में घर लौटना पड़ता।
फिर भी उसने उसे डाल दिया।
तीसरा लैंप जल उठा। उसकी लालटेन बुझ गई।
और टोमास धीरे-धीरे घर चला, अपने ही जलाए तीन लैंपों के नीचे।
